name: Edit a timeline event and verify recomputed invoice totals
description: Validates that changing an event's price, date, and coupon instantly recomputes the invoice totals.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S05' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Set the 'Event 2 date' field to 2027-01-16, one day earlier
Assert Invoice 2 totals exactly $104.80 with lines -$14.97, $40.77 and $79.00 (16 of 31 days: -round(2900*16/31), +round(7900*16/31), plus the $79.00 renewal)
Assert the golden badge is no longer shown, because the timeline was edited
